question: i set up the laravel proxy controller and routes but no events come through. i think the post requests are getting rejected
reference_answer: Laravel's CSRF protection blocks POST requests to the event endpoint by default. Add the event route (api/event) to the CSRF exceptions via validateCsrfTokens in your bootstrap/app.php file, which is required for tracking to work.

question: my site is a react spa. do i need extra setup to count page changes, and does going from /products to /products?page=2 count as a new pageview?
reference_answer: No extra configuration is needed, since Plausible integrates automatically with pushState-based routers like React's. A new pageview is counted when the path changes, but a query-string-only change such as /products to /products?page=2 isn't counted.

question: we want raw event data dropped into our S3 bucket every day. is that self-serve, and can you also include data from before we start?
reference_answer: Raw event exports aren't self-serve: they're part of the Enterprise plans, so you contact Plausible to set them up, and they're delivered daily to S3-compatible storage. question: do i need a paid squarespace plan to add plausible? where does the code go?

question: im on a vpn and my ip keeps changing so blocking my IP in settings doesnt really work. how do i stop counting my own visits?
reference_answer: If your IP changes often or you use a VPN, set the exclusion flag yourself in your browser. Open the Console tab in the developer tools on your site and run localStorage.plausible_ignore=true, and repeat for every domain, subdomain and browser you want to exclude.

question: trying to add plausible to wix, do i need to pay for anything and what settings do i pick when adding the code?
reference_answer: Site-wide code injection is a premium Wix feature, so you need a paid plan. Go to Settings > Custom Code, click + Add Custom Code, paste your snippet, choose All Pages, select Load code once per visit, choose Head and click Apply.

question: My thank-you page keeps recording extra purchases when customers reload it. How do I stop the revenue being counted twice?
reference_answer: Reloaded thank-you pages fire the purchase event again and add more conversions and revenue. You can remove the trigger from the URL after sending using `history.replaceState`, send from a checkout callback instead of a page, ignore old checkouts on your server, or mark the order as tracked in your own store.
